headline: The Monterey County Weekly editorial board weighed in on ballot measures and propositions. Now it’s your turn to decide.
summary: Sara Rubin here, with a suggestion to check your mailbox to see if you’ve received a mail-in ballot yet. If you’re a registered voter in Monterey County, odds are good that it has already arrived.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
